tasks.prompt:
Write a Python class named TTLCache with no imports.

    TTLCache(capacity: int, ttl: float)
    put(key, value, now: float) -> None
    get(key, now: float) -> value or None

Rules, all of which must hold:
1. An entry written at time t is valid while (now - t) < ttl. At exactly now - t == ttl it is expired.
2. get on an expired entry returns None and removes that entry.
3. get on a live entry counts as a use for LRU recency, but does NOT extend its expiry.
4. put on an existing key updates the value, resets that entry's expiry clock to the new now, and counts as a use.
5. On put, if the cache is at capacity, first purge every expired entry; only if it is still at capacity, evict the least recently used live entry.

Return ONLY a single Python code block. No explanation.

asserts: assert c.get('b', 3.5) is None, 'LRU victim should have been b'
assert c.get('a', 9.99) == 1, 'a must still be live just under ttl'
assert c.get('a', 10.0) is None, 'get must not extend expiry; boundary is half-open'
assert c2.get('x', 14.0) == 9, 'put on existing key must reset the expiry clock'
assert c3.get('p', 10.5) is None, 'expired p should have been purged'
assert c3.get('q', 10.5) == 2, 'q was live and must survive; purge precedes LRU eviction'
